title: [CQ-V04b] Runner focused check dispatch client
definitionOfDone: Each check the daemon says the task owes is dispatched with its frozen definition (checkId, command and approved protected entries), in an environment listed in settings.checkEnvironments, and observed exactly once over /runner. An unlisted environment or a daemon refusal dispatches nothing further for that check.
A check job that exits 0 but changes any materialized snapshot file is recorded as 'inconclusive', never 'passed'.
The VM is deleted on every path (refusal, disconnect, timeout, crash), and the runner key never appears in output or logs.
Fresh verification `node --test scripts/tests/local-runner-dispatch.test.mjs` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
